land_pattern.notes: NO recommended land pattern in this datasheet - sec.8 is 'SOT-23-6 Package Outline Dimensions' only, so pad_size_mm and row_spacing_mm are deliberately not filled (they would be invented). Use a standard IPC SOT-23-6 footprint. Outline dimensions that constrain it (mm, sec.8 table): A 1.050-1.250, A1 0.000-0.100, A2 1.050-1.150, b (lead width) 0.300-0.500, c (lead thickness) 0.100-0.200, D (body length) 2.820-3.020, E1 (body width) 1.500-1.700, E (lead-tip span) 2.650-2.950, e (pitch) 0.950 BSC, e1 (pin1-to-pin3 span) 1.800-2.000, L (foot length) 0.300-0.600, theta 0-8 deg. Pins 1-2-3 on one side, 6-5-4 on the opposite side (pin 6 opposite pin 1).
